parts.text: Iron ore contains iron( III ) oxide, Fe 2 O 3 . A blast furnace is used to extract iron from Fe 2 O 3 . Equations for some of the reactions in the blast furnace are shown. equation 1 C + O 2 → CO 2 equation 2 CaCO 3 → CaO + CO 2 equation 3 CaO + SiO 2 → CaSiO 3

parts.label: a
parts.text: (a) Equation 1 shows the combustion of carbon in the blast furnace.

parts.label: b
parts.text: (b) Iron( III ) oxide, Fe 2 O 3 , in iron ore is converted to iron when it reacts with carbon monoxide, CO, in the blast furnace.

parts.label: i
parts.text: (i) Calculate the percentage by mass of iron in iron( III ) oxide, Fe 2 O 3 . percentage = ..............................% [2]

parts.label: iv
parts.text: (iv) Write the symbol equation to show the reaction that occurs when iron( III ) oxide is converted to iron in the blast furnace. ....................................................................................................................................... [2]

ms.label: 1(b)(iv)
ms.text:
Fe2O3 + 3CO → 2Fe + 3CO2
M1 species
M2 correct equation

ms.label: 1(d)(i)
ms.text:
M1 CaO is basic
M2 SiO2 is acidic

parts.label: e
parts.text: (e) Aluminium cannot be extracted from its ore using a blast furnace.

ms.label: 1(e)(i)
ms.text:
aluminium is above carbon in the reactivity series
OR
aluminium is more reactive than carbon

parts.label: f
parts.text: (f) Both iron( III ) oxide and aluminium oxide contain metal ions with a 3+ charge.

parts.label: ii
parts.text: (ii) Deduce the number of protons and electrons in an Fe 3+ ion. protons electrons [2]
